"MediaGet is a universal video and image downloader that lets you easily save media content from different Internet sources.

It currently supports Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and generic websites, allowing available videos and images to be detected and downloaded from a single application.

MediaGet is designed to provide a simple, fast and convenient interface, bringing different download options together without requiring a separate application for each platform."

"Extraction runs on this phone, without an intermediary server or accounts.

Responsible use
Save only your own content or content you have permission to save. Respect authorship, privacy and each platform’s terms. MediaGet is not affiliated with Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Google, Meta or the analyzed websites.

Free software · GNU GPL v3
YouTube: NewPipeExtractor 0.26.5, embedded on your phone. Source code and licenses accompany this release."
